sentences.en: There are many misleading similarities between Ukrainian and Polish languages.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰语和波兰语之间有许多误导性的相似之处。

sentences.en: There are similarities between the Indonesian and Polish flags.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚国旗与波兰国旗有一些相似之处。

sentences.en: I am not writing about myself. Any similarity is purely coincidental.
sentences.zh: 我写的内容不是关于我自己。任何相似性都是纯属巧合。

senses.zh: 相似(性)，类似(性)；相似之处，类似点

mnemonic: 词根记忆：similar（类似的）+ity（情况，性质）→相似
